condition: Casting an array containing a struct with a null-typed field to its own type, when the struct is sliced or nested in a list with more structs than rows, returns an invalid array whose null child has the wrong length (RecordBatch.cast raises ArrowInvalid).
workaround: Skip the cast when the array or batch already has the target type, or read the whole table with read_table before casting so nothing is sliced.
